item.title: The Beans Know Something We Don’t: Ajogu’s The Therapeutic Tape and the Case for its cultural significance
item.dc:creator: David Ojo
item.description: On the 9th record of Ajogu’s “The Therapeutic Tape” is a song titled “The Story Of Process.” On this record, which also doubled as the lead single of the album, the artist does something almost absurd: he talks to beans.

item.title: Item7Go and the Creeping Struggle to Retain What Makes It Unique and Hotly Demanded
item.dc:creator: Redd Penn
item.description: There are businesses that sell products, and there are businesses that become part of people’s everyday lives. Item7Go has, for a while, managed to do both.
